sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 160x120, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 40 mK; optical: 1/2.7in CMOS 4 MP
features: thermal and optical bi-spectrum turret camera with fused/PIP display
optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), lens 8 mm, FOV 39.42 horizontal
thermal detector: uncooled VOx, 160x120, 17 um pixel pitch, NETD < 40 mK, 8-14 um
temperature exception alarm -20 to 150 C, accuracy +/-8 C
perimeter protection VCA (line crossing, intrusion, region entrance/exit) and fire/smoking detection

release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD1217-6 is a thermal and optical bi-spectrum network turret camera pairing a 160x120 uncooled VOx thermal module (NETD < 40 mK) with a 4 MP optical channel for perimeter protection, fire prevention and temperature-exception alarm. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet DS-2TD1217-6_QA_Datasheet_en-US_20231018.pdf.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and optical exposed as separate channels.
